phase.title: Evidence Convergence, Exact Release Verification, and Final Report

required: Current phase/revision and authorized reviewer lineage
Sealed Phase 9 report and automatic advancement authorization
Latest controller-accepted Source Intelligence Bundle Index revision/commit/digest and component accepted identities bound to the exact current source/build identity
conditional: Triggered domain ledgers/resources explicitly referenced by active steps
Live deployment/release/fork/remediation artifacts only when the phase card trigger applies

steps.instruction: Verify exact final source/release identity, the accepted Source Intelligence Bundle Index revision/commit/digest and all relied-on component identities, Phase 0–9 reports, findings/remediation, coverage, limitations and process health. Reject mutable-path-only evidence or unresolved overlay invalidation.
Truthfully summarize every substantive audit process executed or typed NOT_APPLICABLE, including versions, purpose, status, meaningful metrics and limitations.

steps.action: Build the full material-claim assurance case
steps.instruction: Map every material claim to property, threat/failure mode, argument, immutable evidence, evidence-diversity classification, responsible lens, exact source/release identity, status and limitations.
Reconcile exact release/deployment/configuration identity and the completed deployment gas report.

steps.action: Perform live-deployment attestation only when triggered
steps.instruction: Bind deployed state/code/configuration evidence when required; otherwise preserve explicit NOT_APPLICABLE.
Ensure correlated/procedural evidence is labeled accurately.
Produce the evidence-bound Markdown final report, supplement if required, assurance-case ledger and separate deployment-gas report.
Before the Phase-10 report, create the closure manifest with Phase-10 report/automatic-authorization fields PENDING_BY_SEQUENCE and seal its digest.

Update the canonical Security Traceability Graph for this phase, enumerate and reconcile every obligation due now, add stable OBL-* records for new later-phase work, and freeze current graph/ledger digests for the Phase Report. An OPEN/IN_PROGRESS obligation due in this phase blocks sealing. Classify every material observed change under the Evidence Invalidation Matrix before reusing affected evidence.

steps.action: File the Phase-10 report and authorize terminal closure automatically
steps.instruction: Reference the pre-closure snapshot digest, file the Phase Report, and enter AUTO_ADVANCE_READY. Do not wait for human approval.

steps.action: Create terminal closure manifest and complete automatically
steps.instruction: Create a new immutable terminal closure manifest referencing the pre-closure snapshot and final Phase-10 report digest; record AUTO_AFTER_SEAL authorization instead of a human-response digest. Never mutate the pre-closure artifact. After validation, set campaign status COMPLETE.

phaseRequirement: Add material CLAIM-* nodes and prove backward traceability to accepted evidence; close or explicitly limit every material traceability path.

sealingCriteria: All mandatory phase-card steps completed or have a permitted typed terminal limitation/failure disposition.
Phase-specific structured filing is complete, exact-source-bound, durable, and digest-referenced.

Source Intelligence Bundle checkpoint verifies the final accepted index and every relied-on component revision/commit/digest against the exact release; unresolved overlay invalidation/rebind or mutable-path-only evidence blocks closure.
Security Traceability Graph is updated for this phase and its current campaign-local digest/reference is recorded.
All obligations due in this phase are reconciled in the canonical obligation ledger; no due OPEN/IN_PROGRESS obligation remains.
Every new later-phase obligation has a stable OBL-* ID and objective completion condition.
Phase Report references phase-specific artifact, traceability graph checkpoint, obligation ledger checkpoint, evidence, limitations, and invalidation triggers.
Required process failures have exhausted repair/retry/recovery or are repaired and verified; silent omission is forbidden.
Every material observed change event is classified under EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION_MATRIX; INVALIDATES/REQUIRES_REBIND work is replaced, reconciled, or carried as a typed OBL-* before sealing.
